Erin (Finance): Heads up — Savant AI (acct SVT-918) is 14 days past due. Invoice INV-2025-3321 for $48,600. Customer emailed asking for a 3-installment plan; we retried the card and it declined. Thoughts?
Priya (CS): Copy of their email: "We hit a vendor cashflow crunch, can we split over 3 months? We want to keep prod running. Happy to sign a payment agreement."
Mateo (AM): They're an active account, usage spiked last month. Happy to push for a split plan but need finance ok + guarantee.
Jamal (Payments): I retried the card at 2024-05-02T09:14Z — payment gateway returned `DECLINE_AVS_MISMATCH`. Logged as attempt_id=pay_8f3b2.
payments-bot: PaymentAttempt failed for INV-2025-3321, amount=48600, reason=DECLINE_AVS_MISMATCH, attempt_id=pay_8f3b2
Erin (Finance): Ok — AVS mismatch usually not transient. Can we ask for updated payment method first? Offer ACH as fallback. If they sign installment agreement, require first installment upfront.
Priya (CS): I can ask for ACH and updated card. Customer prefers to avoid ACH paperwork. They asked if we can start with a smaller first payment (25%).
Chloe (Collections): From collections playbook: for >=30k invoices, we require 30% upfront + 2 installments OR an approved manager exception. We can do a 30/35/35 split with signed agreement and card on file.
Mateo (AM): Customer is willing to provide PO and sign terms. Can we tentatively approve 30/35/35 pending payment method update and legal sign-off?
Erin (Finance): Tentative yes. Need to record agreement in Salesforce and mark invoice as "payment plan - approved (conditional)" so billing doesn't auto-close. Also loop Legal for the agreement template.
Erin (Finance): Action items:
- Priya: request updated payment method + ask customer to sign payment plan (I will grab template)
- Jamal: hold off additional retries until customer provides new payment info (avoid additional declines)
- Chloe: if customer misses first installment deadline, escalate to legal/collections immediately
Priya (CS): On it — pinging customer now.
Jamal (Payments): Noted. I'll also whitelist the account for a single manual ACH push if they supply routing details.
Chloe (Collections): FYI we should flag this as "escalation candidate" if first payment not within 7 days of agreement. I'll add a task in Asana.
Mateo (AM): Thanks. I'll confirm PO + signature timeline with the customer in this thread.
Priya (CS): Customer replied: "We can do 30% today via new card, remainder following monthly invoices. We'll send signed agreement by EOD."
Erin (Finance): Great. Once we get nonce/card token, Jamal will attempt charge. If success, mark plan active and schedule two invoices.
Jamal (Payments): Roger. When you post the token, include the attempt window (I'll try immediate manual charge and mark outcome).
Priya (CS): Sending token now (redacted): `tok_9q3h-redacted`
payments-bot: ManualCharge started attempt_id=pay_8f3b3 amount=14580 (30%) for INV-2025-3321
payments-bot: ManualCharge succeeded attempt_id=pay_8f3b3 status=SUCCEEDED txn=txn_7a1c
Jamal (Payments): Charge succeeded. Posting to billing ledger and will update invoice status to "partial paid - payment plan in place".
Erin (Finance): Awesome. Chloe — can you confirm Asana task + set reminder 30 days for next installment?
Chloe (Collections): Done — task #COL-4420 created, reminder set for 2024-06-05.
Mateo (AM): I'll keep the customer updated. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
Erin (Finance): Closing the loop here. If any hiccup, escalate to me and Chloe.
Priya (CS): Customer confirmed signed agreement attached. All good from CS side.
Erin (Finance): Notes updated in SF and billing. Thread resolved unless follow-up needed. :white_check_mark:
